description: Exact normalization of the donor's money columns to New Zealand dollars at the tax year 2026-27 money level (MC4, MC5). Each normalized column is converted once at the declared rate and then aged once by its index family's donor factor, both rounded half-even to cents. Earnings, rent and liquid assets are quantile-mapped onto New Zealand distributions instead (MC4) and are never converted at the rate.
status: Declared, not active: no New Zealand transport graph reads it yet (G8-w3).

mixed_income.disclosure: Self-employment income (both columns, signed) is aged by Stats NZ QES ordinary-time average weekly earnings growth, the AWE convention; provisional pending Max's ruling on non-wage ageing (H3). No separate mixed-income index is used.

capital_income.disclosure: Interest, dividends, rental income and realized capital gains are aged by AWE growth; provisional pending Max's ruling on non-wage ageing (H3). No asset-return or price index is used.

pensions.disclosure: Private pension income is aged by AWE growth; provisional pending Max's ruling on non-wage ageing (H3).

owner_housing_costs.disclosure: Mortgage interest, mortgage principal and property tax are aged by AWE growth as an interim index; provisional pending Max's ruling on non-wage ageing (H3).

employment_income.reason: MC4 quantile-maps earnings onto IRD wage bands; P1 is parked until its source-period wage bridge and intervals exist (d1952 option A, earnings first).

liquid_financial_assets.reason: MC4 quantile-maps liquid assets; no all-household distribution exists yet (C2), and any interim producer is Max's call (M1).

notes: The rate is the IRS 2024 yearly average for the New Zealand dollar, quoted in NZD per USD, so a donor amount is multiplied by it. Calendar-2024 money is a declared convention covering flows and asset stocks; the donor monetary basis has not been authenticated against a producing manifest. The US build's PERIOD = 2024 and the exporter's _time_period write provide model-period lineage evidence. Money normalization refuses a donor whose recorded _time_period differs from calendar 2024 (G8-w H1); this runtime check is a consistency check, not authentication. No donor file is opened to establish this declaration. Variants V1 and V2 age with their own aging_index profile (G8-w H2). public_pension_income is dropped at CREATE and is not declared.
